content_data.email_purpose: To provide an update on the progress of the Accessibility Strategy implementation and solicit feedback for the upcoming phase.
key_points: Positive feedback from pilot programs on new assistive technology integration.
Successful completion of Phase 1 accessibility audits across key European hubs.
Initial recommendations for digital platform enhancements to improve user experience for all employees and partners.
Overview of proposed Phase 2 initiatives focusing on inclusive training and accessible physical infrastructure assessments.
content_data.call_to_action: Please review the attached Phase 1 summary report and provide any feedback or questions by end of next week to inform our planning for Phase 2.
